acclimation.desc: Reduced-output mixed-reef schedule for new corals, recent frags, or recovering colonies. Intended as a temporary step-up profile.
acclimation.name: Acclimation Mixed

dino.desc: Temporary low-output 6-hour schedule intended to reduce pressure from Ostreopsis/Prorocentrum dinoflagellates while you address nutrients, UV/export, and competition. Disables Lunar/moonlight on push for full darkness overnight; re-enable Lunar manually after treatment.
dino.name: Dino Suppression

fo.desc: White-dominant for natural daylight appearance and fish colour rendering. 10-hour photoperiod. Target ~100 µmol/m²/s at 300 mm.
fo.name: Fish Only

lowenergy.desc: Gentle low-light reef profile with restrained peak intensity and short dusk tail. Suitable for lower-demand LPS and shaded systems.
lowenergy.name: LPS Low Energy

lps.desc: Royal Blue dominant for zooxanthellae absorption. Restrained White, Blue for spectrum depth. Actinic pre/post periods. Target ~120 µmol/m²/s at 300 mm — Hammer, Torch, Brain, Frogspawn.
lps.name: LPS Reef

mixed.desc: SPS-level Royal Blue with LPS-appropriate White. Target ~175 µmol/m²/s at 300 mm.
mixed.name: Mixed Reef (LPS + SPS)

shallowsps.desc: Higher-output SPS profile for shallow tanks or elevated mounting, with strong midday intensity and a controlled evening falloff.
shallowsps.name: Shallow SPS

softmixed.desc: Balanced mixed-reef schedule with a gentler peak and calmer dusk. Good default if Mixed Reef feels slightly too strong.
softmixed.name: Soft Mixed Reef

sps.desc: Royal Blue at maximum for growth. White elevated for high total PPFD. Gradual 4-hour ramp to prevent bleaching. Target ~260 µmol/m²/s at 300 mm — Acropora, Montipora.
sps.name: SPS Reef
